passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Quercus × numantina Ceballos & C.Vicioso.
The native range of this hybrid is Spain. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is Q. faginea × Q. pyrenaica.
